purpose: OneAgent Java log enrichment sonrası log ↔ span eşleşmesi (trace_id + span_id)
query:
fetch logs, from:"2026-11-21T16:42:00Z"
| filter log.source == "Container Output" and contains(content, "airlab.access")
| parse content, "JSON:j"
| fieldsAdd tid = toString(j[dt][trace_id]), sid = toString(j[dt][span_id]), log_svc = j[service][name], msg = j[message]
| lookup [fetch spans, from:"2026-11-21T16:42:00Z" | filter span.kind == "server"
          | fields t = toString(trace.id), s = toString(span.id), svc = spring.application.name, path = url.path],
    sourceField:tid, lookupField:t, prefix:"sp_"
| summarize loglar=count(), eslesen=countIf(isNotNull(sp_t)), ayni_span=countIf(sp_s == sid),
    ornek=takeAny(record(log_svc, msg, tid, sp_svc, sp_path))
